title: Conspiracy to Commit: Information Pollution, Artificial Intelligence, and Real-World Hate Crime
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical relationship between online conspiracy theory searches and real-world hate crimes using deep learning. While it discusses societal values, discrimination based on religion and race, and psychological theories like neutralization (rationalizing deviant behavior), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its AI research.
